note: Questions about one ingested document, each with what the document says and where. `must` is a list of groups; a group is satisfied when ANY of its strings appears (case-insensitive, whitespace and dash variants folded) in the retrieved entries, and every group must be satisfied (several groups = evidence from more than one entry). `absent` questions have no answer in the document: the right behaviour is to say it is not stated.

cases.q: What CPU does the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module use and how fast does it run?
cases.answer: Xtensa dual-core 32-bit LX7, up to 240 MHz

cases.q: How much SRAM does the ESP32-S3 have on chip?
How big is the ROM of the ESP32-S3?
What supply voltage range does the module operate at?
What is the maximum Wi-Fi bit rate for 802.11n?
Which Bluetooth version does the module support?
What data rates does Bluetooth LE support on this module?
What is the centre frequency range of the Wi-Fi operating channel?
How many pins does the module have?
What antenna does the WROOM-1U version have?
cases.answer: an external antenna through a connector (WROOM-1 has an on-board PCB antenna)

cases.q: Which GPIO levels select download boot mode?
Which pins control the chip boot mode?
What is the absolute maximum power supply voltage?
What storage temperature range is allowed?
What is the ESD rating of the module (human body model)?
What moisture sensitivity level is the module rated at?
cases.answer: MSL 3, solder within 168 hours of unpacking

cases.q: What current does the module draw in deep-sleep with RTC memory and peripherals powered?
What is the peak transmit current for 802.11b at 1 Mbps?
What is the Bluetooth LE receiver sensitivity at 1 Mbps?
Why should the module not be exposed to ultrasonic equipment?
cases.answer: vibration can make the in-module crystal resonate and fail

cases.q: What is the ambient temperature range of the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1-N16R8?
Which variants are rated up to 105 degrees C?
Which module variants have 8 MB of PSRAM?
cases.answer: the R8 variants: N4R8, N8R8, N16R8 (WROOM-1 and WROOM-1U), Octal SPI

cases.q: Which variant has 16 MB of flash and no PSRAM?
What are the dimensions of the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1 module?
What are the dimensions of the ESP32-S3-WROOM-1U module?
Which variants have 4 MB of flash and 2 MB of PSRAM?
Can the R8 variants be used up to 85 degrees C, and what does it cost?
cases.answer: with PSRAM ECC enabled the maximum ambient temperature improves to 85 C, and usable PSRAM drops by 1/16

cases.q: What is the typical modem-sleep current at 240 MHz for a dual core running 32-bit data access?
cases.answer: 66.2 mA with peripheral clocks disabled, 81.3 mA with them enabled

cases.q: Which has the wider ambient temperature range, the N8 or the N8R8 variant, and by how much?
cases.answer: N8 is -40 to 85, N8R8 is -40 to 65: N8 is 20 degrees wider

cases.q: Which module is smaller, the one with the PCB antenna or the one with the external antenna connector?
cases.answer: the WROOM-1U (external connector, 18.0 x 19.2) is smaller than the WROOM-1 (PCB antenna, 18.0 x 25.5)

cases.q: Which strapping pins matter for booting into download mode and for choosing the JTAG source?
cases.answer: GPIO0 and GPIO46 select boot mode; GPIO3 selects the JTAG signal source

cases.q: I power the module from a 3.3 V supply. How much current must the supply be able to deliver, and what is the worst TX peak?
cases.answer: the supply must deliver at least 0.5 A; the worst listed peak is 355 mA (802.11b)

cases.q: I need Octal SPI PSRAM; what temperature range can I count on?
cases.answer: the 8 MB PSRAM variants (Octal SPI) are rated -40 to 65 C

cases.q: After opening the sealed bag, how long do I have to solder the module and under what conditions?
cases.answer: within 168 hours at 25±5 C and a stated humidity, because the module is MSL 3

cases.q: Does the module support 5 GHz Wi-Fi?
cases.answer: not stated (the document describes 2.4 GHz only)
